schema: define attribute id, value string; attribute score, value integer; entity item, owns id @key, owns score @card(0..1), plays purchase:item, plays participation:member @card(0..1); entity buyer, owns id @key, owns score @card(0..1), plays purchase:buyer; relation purchase, relates buyer, relates item; relation participation, relates member;
seed: insert $x isa item, has id "SECRET_SENTINEL", has score 1; $b isa buyer, has id "BUYER", has score 100;
purchase: match $x isa item, has score $s; $b isa buyer, has score $v; $s > 0; $v >= 10; let $ns = $s - 1; let $nv = $v - 10; update $x has score == $ns; $b has score == $nv; insert $p isa purchase, links (buyer: $b, item: $x);
cnt5: match $x isa item; insert $r1 isa participation, links (member: $x); $r2 isa participation, links (member: $x);
cnt9: match $seed isa item, has id "SECRET_SENTINEL"; insert $x isa item, has id "SECRET_SENTINEL";
paused: match $seed isa item, has id "SECRET_SENTINEL"; insert $x isa item, has id "PAUSED";
stock_read: match $x isa item, has score $s; fetch {"stock":$s};
